description: IA-58A delivered to the commune November 2019 on loan for the future Museo Gustavo Miretti (a Belgrano cruiser casualty from Ataliva); carries the retouched serial A-574 but the true identity is doubted (A-574 c/n 075 had an air-conditioning intake this fuselage lacks). Stored unassembled in a municipal yard July 2022, reported in its final position in 2025.
museum_name: Pucará Museo Gustavo Miretti Monument, Ataliva
